Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 76: November 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #76 shipped to subscribers in October 2007 (bearing the cover date of November 2007 for Issue 76). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #76 featured a stacked lineup of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

John Woo Presents Stranglehold (cinematic dual-wielding action shooter)
Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation (high-flying aerial combat simulation)
F.E.A.R. Files (supernatural tactical horror shooter)
Dynasty Warriors: Gundam (tactical mech hack-and-slash action)
Stuntman: Ignition (Hollywood stunt-driving simulation)
The Darkness (supernatural first-person shooter)
Bomberman Live (Xbox Live Arcade party action)
Wing Commander Arena (Xbox Live Arcade space combat shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews and art galleries for titles like Halo 3, Halo Wars, Mass Effect, and Lost Odyssey, along with OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
